conviction_note: The cause is mechanical and dated - a Russell quarterly IPO-addition trade that cleared at Friday's close and became effective at Monday's open - and the fall carried the price about five points below a clean round-trip of the run-up it was unwinding, which is why print_vs_bar is +5.1; I take only +1.5 of that into the reaction because the cross-sectional median for a fall this size is negative, because a 14-day ATR of 12.1% is the single worst free-ranker bucket to sit in, and because index-inclusion reversion is normally a multi-day drift rather than a one-day round trip, so the 0.5 between the findings' +2.0 and the emitted +1.5 is that haircut.

cause.label: index_or_flow
cause.what_happened: With no company news and no SEC filing, Scribe Therapeutics round-tripped its Russell 2000/3000 quarterly IPO-addition trade: index funds printed 2,236,400 shares into the close of Friday 2026-09-18 (11.6x the 20-session median of 192,100) at $33.00, the addition became effective at Monday's open, and the stock opened essentially flat at $32.88 (-0.36%) and bled all session to close -15.00% at $28.05, which is 5.7% BELOW its $29.74 pre-run-up base of 2026-09-11.

evidence.claim: SCTX is named among the 36 tickers in FTSE Russell's September 2026 quarterly IPO additions, in the Russell 2000 list; preliminary list published 2026-08-21, effective at the market open on 2026-09-21.
FTSE Russell's Q3-2026 IPO additions were effective as of the opening of US equity markets on Monday, September 21, 2026 - confirmed in a same-day release by another name on the same list (EMAT).

Daily bars: 2026-09-18 O31.76 H35.40 L31.76 C33.00 on 2,236,400 shares against a 20-session median of 192,100; 2026-09-21 O32.88 H34.49 L27.32 C28.05 on 528,600 shares. The information-sized volume day is Friday, not the drop day.
Scribe Therapeutics has filed nothing with the SEC since the 2026-09-02 10-Q and the accompanying Item 2.02 8-K; there is no 8-K, S-1, 424B5 or Form 4 on or near 2026-09-21.
The company's own newsroom carries nothing between the 2026-09-08 NYT media item and 2026-09-22; the last press releases are 2026-09-01 (conferences) and 2026-09-02 (Q2 results).

positioning_check: FINRA short interest 778,191 shares at the 2026-08-31 settlement, 4.1% of float, 2.6 days to cover, up 173.3% from 284,711 at the 2026-08-15 settlement (https://www.thecerbatgem.com/2026/09/15/short-interest-in-scribe-therapeutics-inc-nasdaqsctx-rises-by-173-3.html, 2026-09-15). The 2026-09-15 settlement is not published until about 2026-09-24, so the position carried into the drop is unobservable today. 4.1% of float at 2.6 days to cover is not squeeze fuel and I have taken nothing positive from it. There is no skew to read: the baseline records options.status = no_options_market, and SCTX has no listed chain two months after its IPO. Shares outstanding 18,931,680 as of 2026-08-31 per the 10-Q cover (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1853921/000119312526380191/sctx-20260630.htm).

findings.finding: SCTX was one of 36 names in FTSE Russell's Q3-2026 quarterly IPO additions, effective at the open of the drop day itself; the index funds' buy printed into Friday's close at 11.6x normal volume, and by Monday's close the entire +10.96% five-session run-up into that trade had been given back and then some, so the dated mechanical seller has no index-driven supply left to deliver on Tuesday.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The baseline's only two comparable falls are both no-news falls in this same post-IPO regime: 2026-08-13 -11.47% then +1.77% the next close (+0.79% at the open), and 2026-08-25 -16.21% then +1.57% the next close (+5.13% at the open). Two of two up, on an n of two.
findings.why_not_priced: The price has already moved on this - that IS the move. What it does not reflect is that the supply was dated and is now spent: the index execution cleared at Friday's close and the effective date passed at Monday's open, so Tuesday has no forced seller left. If the market had been repricing the business rather than unwinding a flow, the drop day's volume would have been a multiple of Friday's rather than a quarter of it (528,600 against 2,236,400), and the move would have gapped rather than bled - the open was -0.36% and the whole -15.00% was intraday.
findings.independence: The same-day GlobeNewswire release for EMAT, another name on the same list, independently fixes the effective date at the 2026-09-21 open: https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/09/21/3365486/0/en/evolution-metals-technologies-corp-joins-russell-3000-and-russell-2000-indexes-gaining-exposure-to-12-2-trillion-in-benchmarked-assets.html . The 2,236,400-share Friday print against a 192,100 median is an independent price-source confirmation from the tape: https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/SCTX?range=3mo&interval=1d

findings.finding: There is no company-specific information to price: EDGAR shows no Scribe filing since the 2026-09-02 10-Q and Q2 8-K, the company's newsroom is empty between 2026-09-08 and 2026-09-22, and no drop-day analyst action is findable - the most recent rating events are the four post-quiet-period initiations of 2026-08-18 and an H.C. Wainwright Buy of 2026-08-31.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Both of this name's prior 10%+ falls (2026-08-13, 2026-08-25) also arrived with no filing and no press release on the day, and both closed higher the next session.
findings.why_not_priced: A fall with no information behind it has nothing to converge to. The price has moved, but there is no guide, no readout, no covenant and no downgrade fixing a new level, so the only thing holding $28.05 is the last marginal seller of a flow that has ended. Had the business been repriced, an 8-K would exist and the gap would not have been 0.36%.
findings.independence: The company's own newsroom, checked the same day, shows the same absence: https://www.scribetx.com/news . The analyst-action record (Wells Fargo OW $60, Leerink OP $37, Guggenheim Buy $50 all on 2026-08-18; H.C. Wainwright Buy $60 on 2026-08-31) is from https://www.thecerbatgem.com/2026/09/15/short-interest-in-scribe-therapeutics-inc-nasdaqsctx-rises-by-173-3.html

findings.finding: The index give-back is one leg of a larger deflation that is only about half done: the stock ran from $21.19 on 2026-08-17 to $37.25 on 2026-08-24 (+75.8%) on the underwriter initiations that followed the IPO quiet period, and at $28.05 it has retraced only 57% of that melt-up while carrying a 14-day ATR of 12.1% - the realised-volatility bucket that keeps falling.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Inside this same four-week deflation the stock has already fallen -11.47% and -16.21%, bounced about +1.6% the next session each time, and then resumed lower to a fresh low - the bounces did not end the trend, which is the reason this finding is negative and not zero.
findings.why_not_priced: This one IS priced, and saying so is the point: it is the part of the fall I am explicitly not calling an over-reaction, and it is why the positive above is small. If the market treated $28 as cheap, the slide from $37.25 would have found a bid at some point in the four weeks before the index trade, and it did not.
findings.independence: The 2026-08-18 initiation cluster that produced the melt-up is documented separately at https://www.thecerbatgem.com/2026/09/15/short-interest-in-scribe-therapeutics-inc-nasdaqsctx-rises-by-173-3.html

CFO Innovation Spotlight presentation at the Cell & Gene Meeting on the Mesa, Phoenix, 2026-10-05 - a dated forum but two weeks past the scored window.

A peer or sector cause in the in-vivo lipid gene-editing space on 2026-09-21 that would make this a sympathy move - nothing found; the nearest data point is CRISPR Therapeutics trading about -1.3% on 2026-09-20, which is not a sector event.
An options chain to read 25-delta skew from - SCTX has no listed options two months after its IPO, so the baseline's direction anchor (0.2) cannot be improved.
The FINRA 2026-09-15 short-interest settlement, which would show whether shorts pressed into the index trade - not published until about 2026-09-24.
A Nasdaq halt or exchange notice on 2026-09-21 - none found; the fall was a continuous intraday bleed, not a halted repricing.
baseline_tension: Mixed, and I have discounted for it: the finding agrees with the drop-day volume (2.75x is the light, non-informational bucket, and the genuinely informational volume day was Friday at 11.6x, not the drop day) and with this name's own 2-of-2 bounce history after comparable no-news falls, but it cuts against the cross-sectional prior of -0.30% and squarely against the best free ranker of all, 14-day ATR at 12.1%, which is the high-volatility bucket that keeps falling - so the emitted +1.5 sits 0.5 below the findings' +2.0 and far below the +5.1 fundamental overshoot.
